thread:
mira: Quick UX check  streaming chat controls + prompt library overlap. Two ideas: tiny inline pill on the last message vs consolidated composer controls. Thoughts?
jon: Inline pill is quick for power users but it jumps when the prompt drawer slides over. Composer controls are stable.
sahil: Accessibility: inline pill can break SR reading order unless we mirror a hidden stable element. Also need aria-live for streaming start/stop announcements.
ana: (typo? but we used ana) ana: Copy: use 'Stop' not 'Pause'. For regenerate, prefer 'Regenerate' full string in menus, shortened on pills. Tooltips sentence-case.
phil: Token counter conflict: when prompt library opens it currently overlaps the counter. Suggest a compact header icon that expands to the full count when clicked. Use aria-live="polite" and batch visual updates to ~200ms to avoid layout thrash.
jon: Keyboard: Esc to stop, Cmd/Ctrl+Shift+R to regenerate. If stop is triggered by keyboard, focus briefly goes to stop control, then to the generated message.
mira: Visual idea: subtle shimmer on incoming tokens; when stopped it becomes a static marker. Respect prefers-reduced-motion.
sahil: Perf note: avoid per-token DOM updates; keep exact counts in telemetry but throttle renders. Also reserve width for token badge to avoid shift.
mira: Action items: jon -> header-icon mock + collapse animation; sahil -> a11y live region + debounce spec; ana -> copy strings; phil -> shimmer animation props. Drop mocks in #design-review, will experiment behind feature flag.
